policy: Development-only advisories may be accepted for a limited time with the owner's written approval. Production dependencies may have none.

exceptions.reason: No release of eslint, @eslint/eslintrc or typescript-eslint accepts minimatch 11 as of 2026-11-04. Forcing it would be an untested major-version override, and eslint 9 calls minimatch 3 as a function, which minimatch 11 does not export. The glob patterns come from this repository's own lint configuration, not from users, and none of these packages ships in the build.
